reason: Fast Landing tests-only diagnostic authorization for KF-P0-22 / KF-P0-19 same-root WhatsApp stale-socket generation fencing. Initial implementation is exactly one mandatory WP0 test path and production is forbidden until a fresh exact-head causal RED isolates this behavior with unknownBlockers=0. Existing createSessionGenerationFence/createSocketGenerationGuard authority is PRESERVE; no second scheduler, queue, retry engine, session authority, dependency, workflow or routing change is authorized.
